title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS
description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS The property is located on the third floor of a new building on Ibrahim Dervishi Street in the area of ​​the Commune of Paris. The apartment is organized in a living room together with a living room, two bedrooms, a bathroom with natural light and two toilets. The property is fully invested and furnished. It has full mortgage documentation. For more information, contact us.
